page.layout: One printed page: ornamental head rule, title in capitals and small capitals, then verse set as stanzas in the centre column; faint show-through from the reverse page at the right edge, not transcribed.

main_text.head: AD CLARISS. VIRVM D. Th. BEZAM CARMEN.
main_text.p: INFANS, quum patrias Beza tenellus Vagitu insolito concuteret domos, Miratúsque nouam, non sine Numine, Lucem cerneret acrior:
Illum Pierides, & Charitum chorus, Illum cum Clario Pallas Apolline Viderunt faciles: vidit & addita Cunctis laeta Lubentia.
Montisque vnanimes verticibus sacris Conuenêre sui: qua strepit vngula Fons reclusus equi limpidus alitis: Qua Lauri virides comas Spargunt, Phoebigenûm praemia frontium.
Atque umbras gracilès consiliantibus Dant Musis. Pueri Cynthius Indolem Princeps laudibus extulit.
Hunc carmen citharaiußit Eburnea Maiorem reliquis reddere vatibus.
Hunc Lauri voluit tollere pluribus Ornatum foliis caput.

page.notes: The initial I of INFANS is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as I. Words in the verse are copied as printed; "Infans" set with the woodcut initial. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The final word "Fratris" is set at the right, as printed.
